user.title: Tyre tracking
user.description: Declares the first car. Everything else — tyre sets, the odometer source, every manoeuvre, and any further vehicle — is then handled in the Tyre Tracker editor, in the sidebar or at {url}.

data_description.vehicle: Names the device and its entities, for example “Alfa GT”.
data_description.odometer_entity: Leave empty if the odometer is read by hand: a field will then appear on the card.
data_description.initial_odometer: Where the counter stands today. Sets the starting point: a set fitted before the odometer is known starts counting from zero.

abort.already_configured: Tyre Tracker is already set up — every vehicle is managed in its editor.

mount.name: Fit a set
mount.description: Swaps: stops the outgoing set's count and sets the incoming one's starting point. Same as picking the set in the select.

tyre_set.name: Set
tyre_set.description: Name of the tyre set to fit.

position.name: Position
position.description: Where to fit the set. No effect on a four-wheel set, which takes both. Omitted for a pair, it goes to the front.

odometer.name: Odometer
odometer.description: Odometer reading at the time of the swap. Omitted, the last known reading is used.

set_odometer.name: Record the odometer
set_odometer.description: Records the vehicle's odometer, without swapping.

adjust.name: Correct a total
adjust.description: Sets a set's total mileage. For taking over existing tracking, or repairing a mistyped swap.

total.name: Total
total.description: Total mileage to keep for this set.

retire.name: Move to history
retire.description: Freezes a set's mileage and prevents it from being fitted. The set stays visible, filed away in the history.

odometer.name: Odometer
odometer.description: Reading at the time of removal. Useful if the set is fitted: the last kilometres belong to it.

restore.name: Put back into service
restore.description: Makes a set that was moved to the history fittable again.

unmount.name: Remove
unmount.description: Takes the tyres off a position without fitting others. The removed set's mileage is stopped.

odometer.name: Odometer
odometer.description: Reading at the time of removal.

rotate.name: Rotate
rotate.description: Records a rotation on a fitted four-wheel set: each wheel moves to the other end of its side. The mileage is unchanged, the reminder starts again, and the pressure sensors follow their wheels.

odometer.name: Odometer
odometer.description: Reading at the time of the rotation.

unknown_set.message: “{set}” is not a tyre set of {vehicle}.

set_retired.message: “{set}” is in the history and can no longer be fitted. Put it back into service first.

not_mounted.message: “{set}” is not on the car: there is nothing to rotate.

pair_not_rotatable.message: “{set}” is a pair. Fit it to the other axle instead of rotating it: two tyres change ends by being moved, which is a swap.

odometer_backwards.message: An odometer does not go backwards: {value} km is below the {tracked} km already recorded. Change the odometer source if the counter really did change.
